content:
sam: Heads-up — noticed a spike of parallel terraform plan jobs queueing and then failing with runner-pool starvation on infra repos. Root failure: GH Actions runners hit concurrent job limits and old runs get canceled. Example logs pasted below.

gha-bot: [action: terraform-plan] Job failed: no available runners matching labels 'gpu,private'. step waited ~6m then canceled.

maya: Seen this too after we bumped matrix parallelism for the GPU tests last week.

alex: Could be interplay with node churn — runners are ephemeral on GKE autoscaler, preemptions + image pulls = slow scheduling.

sam: Sample pod state during failures: ImagePullBackOff and NodeNotReady spikes. Not pure quota — looks like burst scheduling + preemptions.

lee: Immediate mitigation: reduce matrix concurrency from 8 -> 4 in .github/workflows/infra-ci.yaml to stop the flood.

maya: Also adding a small retry wrapper for cache restore helps reduce transient cancels — actions/cache sometimes fails during heavy load.

sam: Opened a tiny PR to rate-limit terraform plan steps with an internal queue key to avoid back-to-back runs for the same repo: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/1234 — can one of you review?

alex: Long-term: proposal to create a dedicated runner pool for infra-critical jobs (reserve 2 preemptible nodes for infra-only) so plans don't compete with heavy GPU CI. Will draft cost estimate.

oncall-bot: alert: runner-pool-utilization > 95% for 8m in us-central1, correlated with 6 concurrent GH workflows at 09:12 UTC.

sam: Note — reserved nodes will add cost; ops asked for an ROI estimate before we spin up anything. Keep that in the RFC.

maya: Quick actionable change: add 'concurrency' key to workflows to prevent duplicate plans per PR. That alone should reduce storms from multiple pushes.

alex: Also consider splitting terraform plan and apply into separate workflows (apply requires manual approval). That reduces contention during active dev churn.

lee: Doing the immediate revert of matrix for infra-tests now, will backfill a smaller GPU canary matrix later.

sam: Action items: (1) lee revert matrix now, (2) maya add retry wrapper for cache restore, (3) alex draft runner-pool RFC + cost estimate, (4) sam monitor queueing for 6h and report back.

maya: I'll add a tiny retry snippet for the cache step and PR it. Example I plan to use:

```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do
  actions/cache restore --key $CACHE_KEY && break || sleep $((i * 5))
done
```

sam: Also adding more debug logging for runner registration so we can see why churn happens (OOM, preempt, node deletion).

alex: I'll collect the cost numbers and open the RFC this afternoon.

sam: Marking this thread resolved for now. Will reopen if queueing resurfaces in the next 6 hours. :thumbsup:
